fields.description:
Frappe Default: normal Frappe upload (if an S3 attachment app is installed, files go to S3 through it).
Local: always saved on this server's site files.
Amazon S3: uploaded directly to the bucket below (AWS or S3-compatible).
fields.label: Storage Backend

fields.description: Default for uploads. Private files are only visible to logged-in users with access; keep unticked for item/website images. Can be changed per upload on the upload page.
fields.label: Save as Private Files

fields.default: jpg, jpeg, png, webp, gif, pdf, doc, docx, xls, xlsx, csv, ppt, pptx, odt, ods, txt, zip
fields.description: Leave empty to allow every file type.
fields.label: Allowed Extensions

fields.description: 0 = no limit (the site's own max_file_size still applies)
fields.label: Max File Size (MB)

fields.description: Only for S3-compatible services (MinIO, Wasabi, DigitalOcean Spaces, Cloudflare R2). Leave empty for AWS.
fields.label: Endpoint URL

fields.description: Leave empty to use the server's IAM role / environment credentials.
fields.label: Access Key ID

fields.description: Optional CDN / CloudFront URL, e.g. https://cdn.example.com
fields.label: Public Base URL

fields.description: Untick if your bucket blocks ACLs and is made public by a bucket policy instead. Direct S3 uploads are always public: use Frappe Default or Local for private documents.
fields.label: Set public-read ACL
